rk8s: Kubernetes client for R

Source: R/rk8s-package.R
rk8s-package.Rd

rk8s ports the Kubernetes Python client and Go client-go to R. The package layout mirrors the Python client:

Details

  • A hand-written runtime in R/ - Configuration, ApiClient, load_kube_config(), load_incluster_config(), Watch, DynamicClient, create_from_yaml().

  • Typed API and model classes under R/gen/, code-generated from the Kubernetes OpenAPI specification by the generator in tools/gen/.

Do not hand-edit files under R/gen/; regenerate via Rscript tools/gen/generate.R.
